title: Elizabeth Targ dies of the glioblastoma she studied with healers

tellings.quote: would be Elizabeth Tar the the daughter of Russell Tar who was a psychiatrist and doing brilliant medical research on psychic healers.

plain: The story is that Elizabeth Targ, a psychiatrist doing medical research on psychic healers, died in 2002 of glioblastoma, the same deadly brain cancer she had been studying with those healers. Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a PhD in parapsychology, tells it, describing her as "doing brilliant medical research on psychic healers". He notes that she was the daughter of Russell Targ.
